name: Ao to Ao no Shizuku -A Calling from Tears-
original_name: 青と蒼のしずく-a calling from tears-
source:
The world was drowning because of unprecedented sea level rise. Thanks to science discoveries it has become possible to combat nature, and the world starts to recover.
12 years have passed. This is a story of young people born in such time. Their original village is destroyed by the sea, but they remain among those who have not fled the island. They try to live normally, play normally, fall in love normally before the sight of the ugly sea.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
史无前例的海平面上升曾令整个世界濒临淹没；所幸凭借科学技术的突破，人类终于得以与大自然抗衡，世界也开始逐步复苏。
十二年光阴流逝，本篇讲述的便是诞生于那个年代的少男少女们的故事。昔日的故乡村落虽已被大海吞噬，他们却依然选择留在岛上，没有随他人逃离。在满目疮痍的大海面前，他们努力像寻常人一样生活、嬉戏、相恋。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
